intent_en: To demonstrate the low survival rate of family businesses across generations.
previous_intent: To illustrate the significant attrition of family businesses across generations, emphasizing that only a small fraction survive the transition to the second generation and beyond.
narration_support: Only about a third of family businesses survive the second generation, and another fifty percent don't last until the third.
chart_support: A graphic showing a hierarchy of figures with one highlighted in red alongside a circular chart with a red arc around a building icon, visualizing a small fraction of survival.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly cites statistics on family business survival across generations (1/3 to second, 50% to third), and the chart visualizes this with a 1-in-3 figure representation and a partial circular gauge (approx. 1/3 red arc) around a business icon.
